metadata.name: Coder
metadata.description: Coder v2.36.7 is a self-hosted development-platform control plane with Postgres and a Docker socket for workspace templates.
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: CODER_PG_CONNECTION_URL
environment_variables.description: Postgres connection URL. User, password, host, and database match the database service.

environment_variables.name: CODER_HTTP_ADDRESS
environment_variables.description: Address the Coder control plane listens on inside the container.

environment_variables.name: CODER_ACCESS_URL
environment_variables.description: URL that users and workspaces use to reach Coder. Localhost works for Docker templates on this host only.

environment_variables.name: POSTGRES_USER
environment_variables.description: Postgres role created on first start.

environment_variables.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: Postgres password. The same value is embedded in CODER_PG_CONNECTION_URL.

environment_variables.name: POSTGRES_DB
environment_variables.description: Postgres database created on first start.

volumes.description: Host Docker socket used by Docker-based workspace templates
Coder home directory, including the dev tunnel URL

before_install.en_us: Open http://localhost:7080 and create the first user. Set CODER_ACCESS_URL to an address workspaces can reach before using templates that are not on this Docker host. When Coder can write to the mounted Docker socket, it can control the host Docker daemon. On a rootful Docker host, users or templates that can make Coder issue Docker requests may gain host-root-equivalent access. Restrict Coder to trusted users and templates. On Linux, if Coder cannot write to the socket, add the host docker group id with group_add. The official Compose file leaves that value commented because it differs per host. The Postgres password is a catalog literal and the database port is not published. Replace it in both POSTGRES_PASSWORD and CODER_PG_CONNECTION_URL if this host is shared. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit those literals; they do not substitute Compose variables.
